source: Binance Web3 read-only BSC directory and quote audit
method: One bounded read-only audit counted provider-returned BSC representations by issuer, then recorded whether identity research, timestamped market data, quote retrieval, and unsigned transaction construction were available for a 6 USDT input at the observation time.
limitations: The directory response is a returned-match snapshot, not a verified complete catalog.
Quote and build readiness are point-in-time and specific to the audited 6 USDT input; they do not establish future availability or tradability at other amounts.
Provider/route limitations are kept separate from Ariadne adapter or contract failures.
This aggregate is derived from the local audit record; individual representations and raw provider payloads are not published here.
